selection: Earliest strict best validation MAE for MAE; validation RMSE for MSE. Trained epochs only.
weighting: Equal CVE; per-CVE gradient accumulation, one optimizer step per batch.
shuffle: random.Random(seed + epoch), retained from CT02 for controlled arithmetic
readout: Observed TOKEN vectors only from the same combined DM graph; exclude GLOBAL root in both arms.
missingness: Zero inactive source after projection; retain original four-value DMGN presence mask.
linear_context: D and M are split from the combined DM graph, not separately contextualized graphs.
interpretation: Retrospective, repeatedly inspected development cohort. Not independent confirmation or historical forecasting.
